parse.title: Tournament
parse.text:
Tournament mode is a new mode added in Update 10. This mode allows you to compete against other players to gain rewards. Tournaments last one week. To access the tournament menu, go to the yellow tournament board next to Zen-o, which is located to the right of the stairs leading to the Play area. Starting second week of the Tournament, unit traits are disabled but the relic still allowed.

"Fight to surpass rivals in your bracket, and get rewarded based on your ranking! Brackets are assigned randomly every tournament."
